title: THE STAMINA WORD IS INSIDE ITS BAR
why: The critic named three bar styles bottom left: armour and health carry their words inside the bar, stamina carried its word past the right end. It is inside the bar now, in the armour word face, on a slightly darker fill so it reads.
now: The stamina word sits inside its bar like armour and health.
